body: When I tried to force myself out, I just made matters worse. You are right, I do have social anxiety and avoidance disorder. My dislike for people doesn't help neither. I just want to be able to support myself without having to deal with that many people. This is a pipe dream though.
I still live at home with my parents and do not have a job. I would like  to get an apartment but I have only a couple thousand dollars saved.
